fact_text: A real estate investment trust (REIT) splits a property into units so smaller investors can share in it; the executive's example was a PKR 10-15 crore property split into units priced near PKR 10 each.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: Private placement of REIT units is open to high-net-worth investors who meet the regulator's fund threshold; once listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, REIT units trade like ordinary shares.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: A brokerage account for trading listed REIT units can be opened with a minimum of about PKR 5,000, the executive said, similar to opening a regular stock trading account.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: A REIT is run by a REIT management company under trustee oversight, a regulated governance structure that gives investors protections usually absent in conventional direct real estate ownership.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: A REIT must distribute more than 90% of its income to investors, so most rental and other returns reach unit holders rather than being retained by the manager.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: The JS Investments executive said Hyderabad's economic expansion had not been reflected in its property valuations, a mismatch that offers significant capital gain potential for investors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: The JS Hotel REIT's hotel is in Qasimabad, near Latifabad in New Hyderabad, close to the Hyderabad bypass; the executive said the area has ready infrastructure and connectivity and is still developing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: The hotel will have 139 keys in total, spanning standard rooms, suites and presidential suites, with the room mix set by the demand the market shows for each category.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: Planned amenities include a swimming pool, food and beverage area, meeting and conference halls and a gym, which the executive said are the basic level for a four-star global-standard hotel.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: About 90% of lodging clients in Hyderabad are corporate; the executive said such clients are price-insensitive and prefer multinational brands whose compliance standards they already know.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: The executive said a globally known US hotel brand was chosen because few Hyderabad hotels meet multinational standards, and that such a brand is easier to sell to clients than a local brand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: The company described its hotel REIT as Pakistan's first Shariah-compliant, green REIT with a hotel as the underlying asset, giving investors first-of-its-kind exposure, the executive said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: Investors get exposure to hotel real estate rather than the hotel operating business; the executive expected its dividend yield to exceed residential, retail or office REITs, possibly reaching double digits.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: The executive said market expectations are that PIB yields will fall, possibly into single digits, which would make a double-digit hotel REIT yield more attractive to investors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: The executive said the hotel would create local jobs, train staff to global four- and five-star standards, source food and beverages from nearby farms and support human development indicators.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: JS Investments' real estate research department has accumulated over 150 million square feet of property data, from Karachi to Nathia Gali, as stated at the time of the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: A REIT can hold residential, office, retail and hotel assets together, so a weak segment can be offset by another; the executive said this diversifies the portfolio and reduces risk.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: The Pakistan stock market stood at about 170,000 points on the publication date, as reported in the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)

fact_text: The executive said REIT investing is still unfamiliar to many Pakistanis, so participation growth depends on investor education and marketing, as the early stock market also grew with knowledge.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Hyderabad's JS Hotel REIT Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-28)
